title: Unit Event — The First Concerto — Episode1 Our Everything In This Song

meta.Episode: Episode1 — Our Everything In This Song
meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD each contend with the missions Ken has assigned them, with their sights on the day they surpass RAD WEEKEND. Toya's task is to write every track they're going to use for their event, and he attempts to pour everything into a song, but that's easier said than done...

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, this doesn't sound right either...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This song won't be able to reproduce the atmosphere from that night.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (You can do better.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Find a way to give it more energy.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Find a way to write a song that can help us surpass RAD WEEKEND...!)
A few months earlier
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Even if you do get better, just putting on events like you've been doing until now probably won't get you far.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's hard to make a flame burn bright when it's close to going out. You won't get many chances.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why... You're going to split up the work.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: These will be crucial steps towards putting on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: First, Akito, you go reignite your audience.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Our audience...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I see...
We're each going to do what's necessary for us to actually surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito's being tasked with reigniting our audience. That suits him very well, so I'm sure he'll succeed...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Next, Toya, you're up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm listening...!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You're going to be the “track maker”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll be solely responsible for all the tracks your team is going to use to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm...going to make all of them...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Obviously, a good event needs good songs. On top of that, you're trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND, which means they need to be of a certain quality.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, Toya is really good at this stuff...
But making him do everything on his own doesn't seem fair...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Then, I'll take this opportunity to explain my reasoning.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: First, let me talk about the songs we made for RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The three of us made them together by putting everything we felt and experienced into them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everything you felt and experienced...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That's right.
Especially because it was the last event Nagi could sing in.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We made sure not to leave anything behind.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And it was worth it in the end because we'd never performed at that kind of level before...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, you'll need to come up with songs that can surpass that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Songs that encompass everything you've felt and experienced.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Without anything like that, it won't matter how well you perform. You won't be able to surpass the atmosphere we created that night. Not ever.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Yes, I understand that much...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The atmosphere from that night wasn't born from Ken or the others' singing. Those songs moved everyone's hearts. It was clear even from that video...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Am I really up to the task...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe we have plenty of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Especially after making the decision to carry everyone's dreams forward. Yours, Nagi's Taiga's and all the locals...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I doubt our resolve falls short of you and your team's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, me coming up with songs that can reflect that is a different story...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I think you can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You do...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I had a chance to listen to what you've all already made...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And there's something different about your songs, Toya. A lot of them didn't require lyrics. I could feel what was going on through sound alone...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: This is just my guess...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But I think you've had a special connection to music since you were a child. A connection that most people don't have.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Those experiences are what I believe will help you create...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Don't just play aimlessly.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Think about what the composer was thinking and feeling. Think about why they wrote this song the way they did.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Of course, Toya, you're not the only one who can weave their feelings and emotions into their songs.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And I know those feelings are very complicated. Still, I think you have the best shot at turning what your team is feeling into music.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. I did feel a lot of different emotions when I listened to your song, Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too. As sad as I am to hear that our old songs won't really do...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think you'll do a great job of making songs that reflect how we really feel, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Still, I know I'm asking a lot of you...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And it'll certainly be tough, but do you think you can handle it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you believe that I'm going to surpass the songs that you and your team made, Ken... Then I'm up for the challenge...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Looks like we're both about to have it rough.
But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're counting on you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You can do it, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you!
